description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named SecureWindowActivity that demonstrates how to create a secure window using WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE. It includes methods for initializing the activity and setting window flags to prevent screen captures and mirrorings of its content.

classes.name: SecureWindowActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates setting a secure window to prevent screen capturing and mirroring.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets its content view, and applies security flags to its window.
